question: As of July 2023, who is the Chief Minister of Karnataka?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Siddaramaiah**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Siddaramaiah** is the current **Chief Minister of Karnataka** as of July 2023.
 
• He is a leader of the **Indian National Congress (INC)** party.
 
• Siddaramaiah has previously served as the Chief Minister of Karnataka from **2013 to 2018**.
 
• He is known for his **social welfare schemes** and initiatives aimed at improving the lives of the underprivileged.
 
• He has a background in **law** and has been actively involved in politics for several decades.
 
• His administration focuses on issues such as **agriculture, healthcare, education, and infrastructure development**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Jagadish Shettar**__

 __
 
• Jagadish Shettar is a former **Chief Minister of Karnataka** from the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)**.
 
• He served as Chief Minister from **2012 to 2013**.
 
 
 
• **Basavaraj Bommai**__
 __
 
• Basavaraj Bommai is a member of the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** and served as the Chief Minister of Karnataka before Siddaramaiah.
 
• He took office in **July 2021** and his tenure ended in **May 2023**.
 
 
 
• **BS Yedurappa**__
 
 
• BS Yedurappa is a senior politician from the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)**.
 
• He has served multiple terms as the Chief Minister of Karnataka, with his most recent term ending in **July 2021**.
